input.quote: Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties.
input.rationale: The commercial model is a pure revenue share on actual auction activity: fees are shared "revenue generated as a result of this Agreement, or Customer's use of the Services" per Exhibit (p0023), with no minimum spend, minimum volume, take-or-pay or shortfall mechanic anywhere in the Agreement. Section 1 expressly makes the arrangement non-exclusive and places no volume restriction on AP's ability to sell Inventory elsewhere, and Section 13 confirms no minimum revenue level is guaranteed by either Party. This meets the preferred position (no minimum commitment; fees for usage/ordered services only), so no redline is warranted. Noted for context only (not flagged here): the one-year Initial Term is non-terminable for convenience and Kubient is entitled to fees generated during any termination period — but those are fees on actual revenue, not a purchase commitment, and term/exit is addressed under the termination rule.
